item.title: Hampshire farm welcomes first piglets of the year in heartwarming video
item.description: A Hampshire farm has welcomed its first piglets of 2026 in a heart warming video showing the litter with their mum.

item.title: 12,000-strong ravers flocked for an epic all-night party - in pictures
item.description: In 1992 some 12,000 ravers packed themselves into Matchams Stadium for the legendary Fantazia event Summertime.

item.title: Fareham councillors say Suella Braverman should resign over Reform defection
item.description: Calls have been made for Suella Braverman to resign her seat following her defection to Reform UK.

item.title: Kitchen bringing Romanian and British culture together opens in pub
item.description: A pub in Southampton is now home to a kitchen seeking to bring cultures together through traditional home cooking

item.title: Driver launched AI-powered 'FOI blitz' on Southampton council amid legal complaint
item.description: A driver unleashed an email "blitz" on Southampton City Council after civic chiefs rejected his demand for a six-figure settlement over a £35 driving fine.

item.title: Historic Southampton high street pub on the market for a new owner
item.description: The Red Lion, a historic pub on Southampton's high street is up for sale for just under £700,000.

item.title: Care home rated outstanding after issues raised
item.description: A Southampton care accommodation was rated outstanding by the Care Quality Commission, after concerns about the home were raised.

item.title: End in sight for M27 resurfacing as project reaches next stage of works
item.description: After months of 50mph limits, drivers on the M27 are finally approaching the last stretch of a major resurfacing scheme between junctions 5 and 7.

item.title: Married man jailed for paying £20 to have sex with teen girl in park
item.description: A married man who had sex with a 15-year-old girl in a Southampton park has been jailed

item.title: Vehicles damaged with road 'crumbling' under weight of HGV traffic, resident says
item.description: Anger over a ‘crumbling’ road used as a route to a council development has come to a head after a resident rescued a driver whose car became stuck in a ditch.
